lines.en: Deep red scales shift in the light.

lines.zh: 我四条腿，走的不是地面
lines.en: Four legs, and I don't walk the ground.
My wingspan is small, but enough.
I came out of an ancient egg.

lines.zh: 龙之手遗迹是我的出生地
lines.en: The Drakvyrn Hand ruins are my birthplace.
I fold my wings before landing.
My tail drags behind me.
My claws grip stone.
I know this stretch of sky.
One leap and I'm airborne.
The edges of my scales darken.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片地形飞一圈
lines.en: I circle this terrain once.
I stand with my wings folded.
A warmth sits in my throat.

lines.zh: 我能吐出点燃东西的火
lines.en: I can spit what sets things alight.
My scales can be made into armor.
So can my bones.
The red on me is deep.
I'm waiting for the wind.

lines.zh: 这片地方以前是我的巢
lines.en: This place used to be my nest.
I dislike being ringed in.
I lower my head and look at my claws.
One wingbeat throws up dust.
I'm young, but not small.
I'm practicing my breath.
Firelight glows in my throat.
You're bigger, but I'm not afraid.
That scale in your hand looks familiar.

lines.zh: 我在你的高度跟你说话
lines.en: I speak to you from your height.
You've entered ground I guard.
My eyes see far.
You smell of eggshell.

lines.zh: 你带着蛋，我认得那味道
lines.en: You carry an egg; I know that smell.
Hatching needs the right place.
In the Nether, you'd get another color.
I haven't decided about you.
Keep your hands away from my egg.
A mark cut into my scales.
I step back, bracing with a wing.
I roared, and it carried.
My breath sputtered.
This is my first such blow.
My scales are a deep crimson.
My tail swept around.
I lower my body.
A scale cracked — and you dare try again?
I don't eat that sort.
What I eat has been burned.
You hold meat; I'm not interested.
Put it on the fire first.
That won't even pick my teeth.
That thing smells of iron.
I prefer living prey.

lines.zh: 我吃矿石和火，不吃你的面包。
lines.en: I eat ore and fire, not your bread.
I'll hunt when hungry.
Move it; don't block my path.
You hit scales.
I'm far heavier than you.
My wing bone struck your shoulder.
I step back, wings opening.
A bump; I flick my tail.
My claws dig in to steady me.
My wingbeat pushed you off.
Don't walk against my tail.
I turn slowly; step aside.
Bump again and I'll take off.
We come from eggs.
Beat me first, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 野生的我不会轻易低头
lines.en: A wild one doesn't bow easily.

lines.zh: 我的鳞色会传给下一代
lines.en: My scale color passes on.

lines.zh: 下界的蛋会是别的颜色
lines.en: Nether eggs take another color.
The nest must be built high.
You don't even have wings.
This isn't the time for that.
I haven't decided to stay.
Talk after we fly.
Something bright on the ground.
I hook it over with a claw.
This scale isn't mine.
I clamp it in my jaws.
This is a little interesting.
I picked this up in the ruins.
I carry it up in flight.
What's on my ground is mine.
Don't grab this one from me.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的火已经亮了
lines.en: The fire in my throat is lit.
You've taken a place you shouldn't.
I'll take off first.
Attacks from above are hardest to dodge.
My breath isn't decoration.
Back off, or burn.
The Drakvyrn Hand taught me this.
My claws are sharp.
You're blocking my nest.
This is my last warning.
I land fast.
Don't look up.
The fire comes first.
You're a step too late.
I circle above your head.

lines.zh: 翅膀的影子落在你身上
lines.en: My wing shadow falls on you.
I'm finding an angle.
Look up and you'll be caught.
Don't look up and you lose track of me.
Two circles and I come down.
My scales flash in the light.
You're hiding behind the trees.
Trees don't stop fire.
I can strike without landing.
The heat gathers in my throat.
Hear the wingbeats?
That's me dropping altitude.
A little lower and I can reach.
My claws dig into your shoulder.
One breath and the fire's there.
My wing bone sweeps across.
My tail cracks like a whip.
One landing and the ground rings.
My claws are long and curved.
And I'm airborne again.
Another breath.
You blocked the claw, not the fire.
Wings folded; I land.
A line cracks across the eggshell.
Deep red shows through first.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手遗迹里醒来
lines.en: I wake in the Drakvyrn Hand ruins.
My first sound is a low growl.
My scales are still soft.
My wings tremble as they open.
These ruins have been empty too long.
I look up and see the sky.
I'm learning how to land.
A spark escapes my throat.
Eggshell remains on the ground.

lines.zh: 这地方又要有一个主人
lines.en: This place will have a master again.
I shake off the shell fragments.
Who's nearby?
I haven't had my first meal.
I head for higher ground.
Fire is only warm air to me.

lines.zh: 落地没控好，腿震了一下
lines.en: I landed hard; my legs jarred.
My wings are soaked and heavy.
Something lodged between my scales.

lines.zh: 这力量灭了我喉里的火
lines.en: This force snuffed the fire in my throat.
Too hungry to fly high.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我在下坠
lines.en: Nothing below; I'm falling.
